title: Ledger row (v1)
description:
One row of the append-only allocation ledger. Rows are IMMUTABLE: every correction is a forward-dated row — a negative `adjustment` against the earliest open month with `correctsLedId` pointing at the corrected row, or a zero-amount `annotation` for narrative context. No exception exists, including a charity-partner scandal: annotate, never restate (FS07-042, ENG-042/046, NEV-019). Disbursed quarters are never restated and no refund is ever clawed back from a charity (COM-053).

HASH CHAIN (FS07-040): `rowHash = SHA-256(prevHash ∥ JCS(row minus prevHash/rowHash))` over RFC 8785 canonical JSON, where `prevHash` is the row hash of the immediately preceding row in GLOBAL insertion order regardless of month (genesis = 64 zeros). Intake for an open month therefore chains straight onto the current global head, and locking a month never blocks a later month's intake.

Money is always integer minor units plus an ISO currency code; reporting currency is CHF with the per-transaction FX rate captured on the row (FS-00 §6.1, ENG-037; the final currency ruling is URS §21 OPEN-26).

At P-M2 the ledger is the committed monthly table maintained by the operator script, restricted to INTAKE types (`pool-in`, `refund-out`, `chargeback-out`, `topup-*`, `month-note`) — no allocation row exists before P-M3, and CI rejects any diff that modifies a committed row (FS07-100, VS-36).

x-psn.artifactPath: (row shape) src/data/ledger/{YYYY-MM}.json in the website repo · rows[] of /ledger/{YYYY}-{MM}.json
x-psn.producer: P-M2: operator script tools/record-purchases (VS-32/VS-36) · P-M3: FS-05 intake + allocator

month.description: Settlement month for intake rows, allocation month for allocation rows. `(month, seq)` is unique.

seq.description: Position within the month. The HASH chain is global, not per-month — do not infer chain order from this field.

type.description: Row type (FS-07 §5.1 verbatim). The P-M2 subset is `pool-in`, `refund-out`, `chargeback-out`, `topup-multiplier-in`, `topup-donation-in`, `month-note` — an allocation type appearing in a v0 file is a scope defect, not initiative (FS07-100).

amountMinor.description: Integer minor units in `currency`. Negative for corrections; zero for `annotation`, `month-note` and `month-lock` rows.

currency.description: Reporting currency (CHF), or the row's own currency where a row is recorded natively.

monthDigest.description: `month-lock` rows only: SHA-256 over that month's rows in canonical serialisation order (FS07-040).

srcAmountMinor.description: Original transaction amount before conversion to the reporting currency.

fxRate.description: The FX rate CAPTURED AT TRANSACTION TIME, not a rate looked up later (ENG-037).

scheduleVersion.description: Required in practice on every money-bearing reference (ENG-084).

correctsLedId.description: Forward correction pointer. The corrected row itself is never touched.

routingMode.description: Category routing is shadow-first behind a fairness-review gate (D27). A `shadow` row's money moved nowhere on contributor votes.

holdStatus.description: The chargeback hold state of an intake row (COM-023): funds accrue and are held through month M+1 before they can be allocated. At P-M2 nothing is ever allocated, so intake simply accrues — the rule is still printed in the published methodology (VS-36/VS-37).

payerName.description: The payer's name if they OPTED IN to being named, otherwise the literal string `unnamed`. Directory naming defaults to unnamed (VS-33/VS-36) — the entitlement JWS at its own URL is the payer's proof either way.

note.description: Narrative text for `month-note` and `annotation` rows. Annotation is the ONLY mechanism for after-the-fact context.

emittingJob.description: Which component wrote the row — e.g. `tools/record-purchases` at v0. Every row states its own provenance.
